Second call concert_book_ticket with artist: "Red-haired Eddie", location: "Los Angeles", add_ons: ["Backstage Pass", "Parking Pass"].

Third call festival_book_ticket with festival: "Coachella", location: "Indio", add_ons: ["Camping Pass", "Parking Pass"].
